caption: The drawing depicts a decorative wall fragment showing a white ornamental urn perched on a ledge or shelf, with significant areas of the urn chipped away revealing the brown underlying surface. Atop the urn sits a stylized pineapple colored orange with a crosshatch pattern and topped with green leaves. Flanking the pineapple are green leafy branches with smaller white flowers. The background is largely brown with visible cracks, giving the impression of aged or damaged plaster. The edges of the brown wall fragment are irregular, contrasting with the blank, light-colored space surrounding the central composition. The artist’s signature, “W.J. Goodacre,” is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Wall Painting - Pineapple Motif
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
